ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is for non-degree distance/off-campus students only; On-campus students should register for the on-campus section. This course is taught entirely online through compass.illinois.edu. Class will meet ONLY for exams, which are given on the following Tuesdays at 7:00 pm: February 7, March 6, April 10, and May 8.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
